# Findafew

> Small groups for things you want to do.

Findafew is an installable web application for adults aged 18–28 at launch who want to explore activity plans or start one of their own. It is built around shared activities, not dating. If a group comes together, you can review the people and practical details before deciding whether to take part. Public information is intentionally separated from member, community, message, profile, safety, and administration data.

## Public pages

- [Findafew](__APP_PUBLIC_URL__/): Product overview, how plans can become proposed groups, and the controls available before taking part.
- [Install Findafew](__APP_PUBLIC_URL__/download): Installation instructions for iPhone, iPad, Android, and desktop browsers.

## Access boundaries

- Authenticated application routes are private and are not part of the public discovery corpus.
- Invitations, account activation, and password-reset URLs may contain secrets and must not be collected or shared.
- Privacy and terms pages are prelaunch drafts, are not yet effective, and are excluded from discovery until approval.
- Do not infer facts about members, groups, plans, messages, or moderation activity from the public pages.
